halfOpenRequests.label: Half-open probe requests
halfOpenRequests.description: Probe requests allowed through in the half-open state before deciding to close or re-open. Lower = cautious single-probe recovery; higher = aggressive parallel re-validation.
halfOpenRequests.synonyms: probe count, recovery test size, probe aggressiveness, recovery test volume, cautious vs fast recovery

cooldownSeconds.label: Cooldown (seconds)
cooldownSeconds.description: Seconds the circuit stays open before transitioning to half-open and probing for recovery.

fallbackBehavior.label: Fallback behavior
fallbackBehavior.description: What to return to callers while the circuit is open: reject = fail-fast/strict, cached-response = graceful degrade with stale data, queue = retry-later/no data loss, static-default = safe placeholder.
fallbackBehavior.synonyms: open-state response, degraded mode, fail-fast vs graceful degrade

statLook.label: Stat display look
statLook.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for stat / KPI cards.

failureThreshold.label: Failure threshold
failureThreshold.description: Number of consecutive failures before the circuit opens and starts rejecting requests.
